title: Aftermath of the Battle and the Shared Cremation of the Martyrs

blocks.text: Back on earth, the struggle leaves the Gilja force exhausted and shaken. As the exhausted Gilja Pathans had fallen asleep, the surviving Singhs harry them, seize horses where they can, and force the enemy remnants to withdraw back toward the royal camp in a state of disorder.

The narrative then turns tender and communal. Now listen to the account of martyred Singh's corpses: the Singhs gather the bodies from the field, sort friend from foe as best they can, and refuse to leave their dead scattered across the ground.

Their answer is an act of collective remembrance. All the Martyrs corpses were piled up on a single pyre at the back of Akal Takht, and from that cremation the community begins to form the memorial memory that will be known through Shaheed Ganj.
